stories.title: Friday Night Football 2026: Playoffs Week 3
stories.summary: It's week three of playoffs for Friday Night Football! See schedules, scores and highlights of high school football throughout the Central Valley.

stories.title: Tulare County sheriff denies allegations after DOJ receives complaint
stories.summary: The California Department of Justice has confirmed it received a letter of complaint against Tulare County Sheriff Mike Boudreaux.

stories.title: Wrongful death lawsuit filed against Fresno Unified over death of 14-year-old Fresno High student
stories.summary: The family of 14-year-old Daniel Padilla Jr., who collapsed during a physical education class and later died, has filed a wrongful death lawsuit against Fresno Unified School District and several school employees, alleging a series of failures contributed to his death.

stories.title: Dolores Huerta honored during Celebration of Life in Bakersfield
stories.summary: Hundreds gathered Friday morning at Dignity Health Arena in downtown Bakersfield to honor Dolores Huerta during a celebration of life marked by prayer, music and tributes to her decades of activism.

stories.title: Deadly crash renews concerns about safety at Friant and Shepherd intersection in Fresno
stories.summary: A deadly crash at the intersection of Friant Road and Shepherd Avenue has renewed concerns about safety at a crossing that officials and advocates say has a history of serious collisions.

stories.title: New Downtown Fresno hotel opens as city leaders push revitalization efforts
stories.summary: After years of planning and construction, Downtown Fresno's newest hotel officially opened Friday, with city leaders celebrating what they say is another major step in the area's ongoing revitalization.

stories.title: Mendota High students build resumes and school spirit through student-run Aztec Shop
stories.summary: At Mendota High School, students are doing more than creating spirit wear. They're running a business.

stories.title: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy celebrates launch of Disney | Champion NFL limited-edition character apparel
stories.summary: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy surprised fans at the Disney Store Times Square to celebrate the launch of the Disney | Champion NFL drop. Just in time for the holidays, check out the latest designs and styles celebrating your favorite NFL team and Disney characters!

stories.title: Man and dog hit and killed by vehicle while walking in northeast Fresno, police say
stories.summary: 49-year-old Wilson Murray and his Labrador retriever were killed Friday morning after police said an SUV ran a red light and struck them in a marked crosswalk at the intersection of Friant Road and E Shepherd Avenue in northeast Fresno.

stories.title: Federal appeals court temporarily blocks controlled detonation of lead azide at Middletown, Iowa US Army plant after being postponed
stories.summary: The temporary stay pauses the emergency permit until the appeals court rules on the request from the Iowa Environmental Council and Sierra Club for a longer-term halt.

stories.title: One Table Fresno returns with meals, coats and holiday groceries for families in need
stories.summary: Thousands of Valley families are expected to receive holiday support this weekend as the sixth annual One Table Fresno returns to City Center.

stories.title: Good Sports: Merced High School's continued water polo success
stories.summary: Even with the temperatures cooling down, the Merced High School Bears are right where they want to be. In the pool, instead of hibernating.
